utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’ll take a look and see what I can manage.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Uli. Let me know what you can cover, and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’ll check what I can cover and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I’m in for the repair drive. Once Rosa sends the full list, I’ll help track what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re definitely in for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, definitely—I’m in for the repair drive. I’ll keep track of what we still need once Rosa sends the full list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m still in for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — could you help spread the word that it’s now Sunday at the community center, and let folks know we’re prioritizing leaky roofs and broken windows?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about Sunday at the community center and mention the leaky roofs and broken windows.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana. Please ask around for what’s still needed, and I’ll keep it organized here.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can ask around, but I’ll need the exact list and time before I commit. I’ll check back with you once I have both.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s fair, Hana. I’ll get the list and time together, then you can check back with me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an eye out for the drop-off spot and let Gus know as soon as you’ve pinned it down.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve pinned down the exact drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — just let me know when it’s set, and I’ll pass the word along to Gus.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can sort and label the donated items, but keep me posted if it needs to be quick.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, sorting and labeling would really help. I’ll keep you posted, and I can bring my toolbox if we need anything else fixed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just let me know if you need me for anything else, but I may need to step away fast.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still checking the exact list and timing, but I’ll get back to you as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — I’m still trying to hear whether the repair drive got enough help. Let me know when you’ve got the list and timing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’m on it, and I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the list and timing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who should I contact if I can help gather tools or supplies too?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll pass it along and keep folks posted—Oren’s helping too, so I’ll make sure he knows you can gather tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks—just send Oren my way if he needs anything. I can start asking around for tools and supplies now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — if you can check the list, I’d rather bring what they’re short on than guess. I’m a bit cautious about the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check the list and see what they’re short on, then I’ll let you know so you can bring the right things.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that’d be a big help. Once you know, just tell me what’s still needed and I’ll bring that.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds encouraging. What kind of help do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check what they’re still short on and let you know soon — that way you can bring exactly what they need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. Just let me know when you find out what they’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can stop by later today and check what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, thanks. Let me know what time works, and I can fit it around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can come by after school pickup, around 4:30 if that works.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Gus. I’ll keep my eyes open for the drive and help with sorting if I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I’ll bring over the hammer and screwdriver soon, and we can sort everything together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. Just remind me again where we’re setting up the drive, and I’ll do my best to help sort.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, so I’m getting everything lined up there. What would you like me to prioritize first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — could you prioritize the exact list of repair supplies and what volunteers are needed first? The Sunday timing helps a lot, too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll pull together the exact supply list and volunteer roles first, then share it with you. I’ll keep it organized for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right — the repair drive. I can still help sort the donated items and mark what works, but keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, that works. I’ll handle the lamp and fence board, and you can sort the donated items.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll sort the donated items and mark what works. Keep me posted if anything else needs a quick hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Mara — I’ll drop the hammer and screwdriver by your porch today. Glad they can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s great — thanks for doing that. Let me know if there’s anything else folks still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Nell — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I find any other tools people still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—did the repair drive get enough help?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet — I still don’t have the full repair list, so asking around would really help. If you can gather what’s still needed, I’ll keep it organized here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can ask around while I’m out—just send me the latest list, and I’ll see what I can gather.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re definitely in for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I’m in—just send me the exact time and item list, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — I’ll send the exact time and item list. Thanks for confirming.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of supplies for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — could you tell me what items are still needed most? I just want to make sure I bring something useful.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly we still need screws, duct tape, batteries, and a few basic hand tools. If you can bring any of those, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. Please send me the details—I may be able to help a little.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send the details right over. Even a little help would be a big help, thanks, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I appreciate it—I'll look it over and see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can send you the details and get you added right away. If you want, I’ll also pass your name along to help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — please send me the details, especially the exact drop-off spot for the supplies and repair kits, and I’ll help point folks there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the drop-off spot and get your name added too. Thanks for helping point folks there!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we have the repair list yet, or should I ask around for what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still checking on the repair list and what’s left to gather, but I can help sort it out if you want to ask around too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, I’ll ask around for what’s still needed. Let me know when you’ve got the list together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m ready to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Mara — I’m checking what they still need right now, and I’ll get back to you soon with the list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — just let me know when you have the list, and I’ll jump in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can stop by later today and see what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That’d be great, Rey — I’m a little scattered today, but the broken lamp and loose fence board are the main things I remember.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll check the broken lamp and loose fence board when I stop by later today.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I commit, can you tell me exactly what the repair drive still needs and when it’s happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help however I can; just remind me what still needs doing, and I can check my toolbox too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren. I’m still waiting on the exact list and timing before I commit, but if you can check your toolbox in the meantime, that’d be helpful.
